items.text: Ty was one of twenty-one squires in a test over the Purelake, throwing bags of coloured powder at each other while flying with Lashings. He led a group of four who attacked as a team, and they turned on Szeth when he started winning. Szeth held them off, even hitting Ty in the face, until his Stormlight ran out and they pelted him into the lake.

personality.text: One of the older squires, he is plainly the leader of his little group; competitive and strategic.
